subject: Opening offensive line and Stroud protection
current_answer: Rutledge is trending toward center over Jake Andrews, Teller and Ingram project at guard, Ersery projects at LT, and Trent Brown has a slight current edge over Braden Smith at RT. Protection has had both strong pickup days and recent stress from Houston's elite pass rush.
next_test: Chart first-unit snaps versus Las Vegas by line combination, pressure source, stunt/blitz handling, and RB/TE help.

subject: Stroud timing and pressure answers
current_answer: Stroud has multiple strong camp timing reports, including throws to Higgins, Collins, Bond, Hutchinson, and hot/checkdown answers to Marks. Defensive pressure still created sacks, picks, and forced movement in several sessions.
next_test: Chart Stroud's Raiders preseason game snaps by pressure, hot route, checkdown, throw depth, and red-zone decision.

subject: Montgomery Marks Jordan Whittington backfield roles
current_answer: Montgomery remains the projected starter. Marks has repeated checkdown and pass-protection evidence. Jordan has juice but a hip issue has opened reps for Whittington, whose roster path is active roster versus practice squad.
next_test: Track first-team RB routes, blitz pickup, short-yardage, two-minute, and Jordan/Whittington preseason usage.

subject: Wide receiver hierarchy behind Nico Collins
current_answer: Collins is the anchor, Higgins has repeated Stroud connection evidence, Dell returned to team drills, Hutchinson has recent explosive first-team work, Bond has camp momentum, and Wayne/Sobkowicz are forcing depth decisions.
next_test: Chart Raiders first-unit WR alignments, two-WR personnel, third-down routes, and return/special-teams reps.

subject: Tight-end route and personnel roles
current_answer: Schultz remains starter. Klein has the strongest rising TE evidence from camp and preseason. Moreau and Stover have receiving flashes. Brevin Jordan is hurt again and projected off the current 53 by Chronicle.
next_test: Chart TE routes and blocks by personnel grouping, especially Klein versus Moreau/Stover behind Schultz.

subject: Edge and interior defensive rotation
current_answer: Anderson and Hunter remain disruptive starters. Clowney has been a major camp addition. Hall and Horton have positive rush reports, McDonald is flashing run-game power, and Solomon Byrd is pushing the edge depth battle.
next_test: Track base/nickel/third-down front combinations and whether Clowney joins Anderson-Hunter on money downs.

subject: Safety nickel and linebacker deployment
current_answer: Pitre is still a nickel/blitz weapon, To'oTo'o is repeatedly making run/screen plays, Blankenship has run-fit and interception evidence, Ramsey intercepted Trey Lance, and Woodaz is pushing LB depth.
next_test: Chart nickel, dime, safety rotation, Pitre blitzes, LB third-down pair, and Woodaz/Speed availability.

subject: Transactions injuries and roster cutdown
current_answer: Mertz and Pitsenberger are on IR, Brett Rypien was signed, Bryce Hall was added at CB, Louis Hansen was added at TE, and Chris Freeman/Montrell Washington were waived. Cutdown remains open.
next_test: Update after Raiders joint practice/game and first cutdown signal.
